scope: Merge-based Pull owned progress, forced lifetime cleanup and pending Cancel completion. Full port remains incomplete.

verification.core: 24 Pull/Fetch/RequestPull tests pass with Apple and bundled Git. Added pre-cancelled Pull test verifies unchanged HEAD/index/config bytes.
verification.native_cleanup: Eight paused process stages pass with both Git engines using actual hidden FetchWindowController and PullProgressWindowController: initial HEAD, config, remote list, branch validation, Pull transport, failure status, post-success HEAD and Reset defaults. Recorded live leader/helper PIDs terminate; closed result state and callbacks stay frozen; late Cancel/retry/post-action/start requests ignored. Completed Pull HEAD mutation retained.
verification.normal_pending_answer: Both No and Yes after successful Pull completion pass with both engines. Auto-close waits for held answer; post-actions, window close and Quit remain gated; successful HEAD and one completion retained after answer. Private completion wrapper invokes original production owner callback.
verification.regressions: Final-source Fetch/Pull streaming and Pull progress receivers pass both engines: raw diagnostics, Unicode/CR/percentage, owned cancellation, fresh retry, conflict suppression/actions, old/new HEAD views, unchanged/No Commit, unrelated-history retry and Reset metadata without mutation.
verification.builds: Unsigned Debug and AppStore builds pass. Both bundle audits pass and both embedded NOTICE files byte-equal source. Universal Git 2.55.0/LFS 3.8.0, EditorConfig/IssueRegex, Finder extension and 99 icons audited.
verification.cycles: Zero AttributeGraph cycles in three final native logs.
verification.inventory: Pinned inventory checker passes. Four Pull/Fetch source mappings updated; statuses remain partial-native.
verification.workflow: Ruby safe YAML parse and exactly one new Pull cleanup receiver step pass. Hosted GitHub CI remains unverified.
verification.site: Local Pages rebuild passes; no deployment or refreshed physical screenshots.
verification.receiver_repair: First cleanup receiver failed before production code execution: producer folder collided with remote-stage clone destination. Renamed producer fixture, added pending-answer cases and reran both engines successfully; shipping sources unchanged after initial builds.

limitations: Hidden/injected presentation without main app launch or physical sheet/pointer/keyboard/focus/light-dark/VoiceOver acceptance.
Every metadata/submodule/conflict-hint/prompt timing, rejected-presentation route, Fetch-before-Rebase preflight and external config/ref races not individually exercised here.
Real network/authentication, signed repository access, Finder activation/badges/background cache and App Store distribution remain incomplete.
Full upstream dialogs, menus, hooks/result questions and application parity remain incomplete. No push/deployment or hosted CI result claimed.
